name: Dragon Tree
hook: Brown leaf tips? Your tap water may be the cause.

steps.title: Bright, indirect light
steps.tip: An east or west window, or a south one behind a sheer. Summer sun scorches it; it copes with lower light.

steps.title: Water when top 5 cm is dry
steps.tip: Then water well. Use rainwater or filtered water: fluoride in tap water browns the leaf tips.

steps.title: Warm, away from drafts
steps.tip: It grows best at 18–30°C. Keep it away from cold drafts and hot radiators.

steps.title: Feed April to October
steps.tip: Use a general liquid houseplant feed in the growing season. Too much burns and yellows the leaf tips.

steps.title: Cut back to branch it
steps.tip: Cut a leggy stem at the height you want; new shoots sprout just below the cut.

steps.title: Check for mites and scale
steps.tip: Check regularly for spider mites, mealybugs and scale insects, the sap-suckers it attracts.

outro: Bright light, filtered water and a dry top: tidy tips for years.
